activity.notes: Representative span from the Model T's introduction in 1908 through Ford's moving assembly-line production system in 1913; this does not claim Ford invented every component of mass production.

sources.title: Building and Fixing Cars — Smithsonian National Museum of American History
sources.citation_text: The Smithsonian describes Ford's Model T era and moving assembly-line production as central to the spread of automobile mass production and its wider industrial influence.
